segments.he:
(קמו) פַּעַם אַחַתדִּבֵּר אֶחָד מֵאַנְשֵׁי-שְׁלוֹמֵנוּ עִם רַבֵּנוּ  זִכְרוֹנוֹ  לִבְרָכָה  מֵעִנְיָן  שֶׁיֵּשׁ  לִפְעָמִים
שֶׁמַּרְגִּישִׁין בְּעַצְמָן שֶׁיּוֹצֵא הַדִּבּוּר מִן הָערֶף וְלֹא מִן הַלֵּב
segments.en: (145.) One of our people was complaining and apologizing before him z"l — since he has great distress from the fact that he has no private place for the service of G-d — for his house is very small and narrow and always there are non-Jews sitting there — as is customary in an inn — and through this his mind is very confused. Rabbainu z"l replied: "Presumably — if Hashem Yisburach knew that all your free will and service depends on having a private place — He would presumably have given you..."
